label: Do you live in a care home - Covid wave 3 (age 75 years)
meta_rows: Do you live in a care home - Covid wave 3 (age 75 years)
Questions about people participant is currently living with - Covid wave 3 questionnaire. Not asked in previous waves.
cat_rows: This category contains data about the family and home where the participant is currently living. This included household grid, relationships, family and conflict change, childcare, caring and housing asked in the 2020-2021 covid questionnaires where the participant was 74 years.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
